ops.title: Release spawnllm 0.6.2 to PyPI
ops.description: CodexConfig.service_tier (default "fast") + developer_instructions + --color never fix. Tag-driven release: after CI green on main, `git tag v0.6.2 && git push origin v0.6.2`; release-pypi.yml builds + publishes via trusted publishing. Do NOT tag v0.5.6 — PyPI already serves 0.6.1.

ops.text: GitHub release for v0.6.2 exists and release-pypi.yml run is green
